head: ROUND
dzh: 奶白燕麦焦糖、大圆角、柔光
den: Milk, oat and caramel, big radii, soft light
nzh: 只用奶白、燕麦、焦糖三色；圆角大，多用圆形和胶囊形；阴影又大又淡、带暖色，字用深咖啡色；照片和插画柔光低对比，整体软、暖、安静
nen: Milk, oat and caramel only; big radii, lots of circles and pills; large faint warm shadows, dark coffee text instead of black; soft low-contrast photos and illustrations, calm and warm overall
